name: Adoric Component

title.zh: Adoric · 看它怎么把加购瞬间做成一张订

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 给 Shopify 商家加客单价的几个 app：商品页捆绑、购物车加购、结账后加售、离站前弹窗，官网把每块单独做成一个产品段并标出各自的 AOV 涨幅。
description.en: 给 Shopify 商家加客单价的几个 app：商品页捆绑、购物车加购、结账后加售、离站前弹窗，官网把每块单独做成一个产品段并标出各自的 AOV 涨幅。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Adoric (https://adoric.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏近黑底带点阵纹理，导航是 Why Adoric / Apps / Affiliate / Blog 加右侧一颗白色 Explore apps 药丸，主标题 Clients come to buy. / Help them buy more.（buy more 是蓝色），下面 Explore apps 与 Book a demo 两颗按钮。右侧浮着两张卡：一张 ORDER TOTAL $50.00 配绿色 Save 0%，一张白色购物车卡带深绿 Buy now 按钮，右下角弹出 +1 item added 的小气泡。往下是一条数字带 24/7 Support、AI Powered offers、8,700 Active shops、705M Added revenue、5.0 Star ranking，再往后按 Bundle / Cart / Upsell 拆成三段，标题分别写 Client come for 1 product. Help to buy 2+ products、Upload any cart. Get yours back, smarter.、Clients already bought. Help them buy again.，各配 +23%、+21%、+8% 的 AOV 提升数字；Bundle 那段还列了 Quantity breaks、Mix and match、Dynamic bundle AI、Add-ons、Buy X get Y、Frequently bought together、Volume discounts、Free gift threshold 八种活动类型。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
